thesis: This episode argues that Microsoft (MSFT) has transformed into a fantastic partner under CEO Satya Nadella, resolving past issues and delivering on promises unlike the Gates and Balmer era. The speaker highlights that Nadella successfully positioned Databricks on the map and notes that Microsoft's desire for the product created beneficial deal dynamics with a strong distribution channel.

claims.claim: The speaker praises Microsoft as a fantastic partner under Satya Nadella, noting they delivered on promises and resolved issues well, unlike the Gates and Balmer era.
claims.quote: And I will say, look, with all the difficulty of the deal and Microsoft being Microsoft, they've been as good a partner. As not only we've had a Databricks but an entire portfolio, I mean, they really lived up and delivered what they said they would do

claims.claim: The speaker credits Satya Nadella with turning Microsoft into a great partner and putting Databricks on the map, stating they have been a great partner ever since.
claims.quote: So it's Kudos to Satya and they put us on the map. And he's been a great partner ever since whenever there's been issues, they always resolve it. So, you know, we're very thankful.
